description: 大臺北地區消防栓分布點位圖 [fire, police and emergency services and drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北自來水事業處. 大臺北地區(包括臺北市、新北市三重區、中和區、永和區、新店區及汐止區7個里)消防栓分布點位. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北自來水事業處. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
